title: Soft Evidence
lyrics:
[verse]
You left a spoon inside my coat
A folded list of things to buy
No grand confession, just a note
To get the bread before it's dry
You never called it anything
You kept your shoes beside the stairs
But every ordinary thing
Was proof that you were there

[chorus]
Soft evidence, all over the room
The second cup, the borrowed perfume
You say we never made a promise
Look at the life we built around it
Soft evidence, easy to miss
A thousand days that looked like this
I don't need a witness to defend it
You were here, and I remember it

[verse]
The photograph was never clear
Your shoulder moving out of frame
I kept the picture anyway
Some things don't need a perfect name

[bridge]
You can have the ending
You can change the story too
But don't erase the mornings
I was making room for you

[chorus]
Soft evidence, all over the room
The second cup, the borrowed perfume
You say we never made a promise
Look at the life we built around it
Soft evidence, easy to miss
A thousand days that looked like this
I don't need a witness to defend it
You were here, and I remember it

[outro]
I put the spoon back in the drawer
And leave your story at the door
